lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Co2S4 (reduced formula Li2CoS2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co centers in octahedral coordination by six S neighbors (about 2.33 Å) and Li centers in tetrahedral coordination by four S neighbors (about 2.23–2.32 Å), while S centers have five geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Li tetrahedra and edge-sharing between Co octahedra.
